summary_1line: The text recounts divine and heroic births, explains the restoration of social order after Parashurama, and describes gods incarnating on earth to defeat oppressive Asuras.

image_candidates.scene_text: From a blazing sacrificial fire, Dhrishtadyumna emerges fully armed with a bow, destined to slay Drona.
The Earth, burdened and sorrowful, appears before Brahma in a celestial assembly of gods, rishis, gandharvas, and apsaras.
The gods stand before Vishnu in Vaikuntha, radiant with discus and mace, as Indra asks him to incarnate on earth.
